## Astraeus 2.7.2

### New
- **A theme change you can see.** Pick a new look with the panel open and it opens from your pointer with a soft edge. Glass frosts the old look over as it goes, Chrome sends a glint round the edge, and Starfall catches a few stars along it.
- **Lyrics only.** In fullscreen, press L to see nothing but the lyrics, big and centred, from any layout, vinyl included. Change the key in Settings or in Edit fullscreen, under Keys.
- **Vinyl with and without lyrics.** Vinyl now has its own two layouts, like the normal player, and slides between them as a song's lyrics come and go.
- **The Media page's waveform is its own switch,** in Settings under Media, and off by default. Fullscreen's waveform no longer turns it on.

### Fixed
- Turning vinyl off no longer leaves the normal fullscreen layout moved around. Vinyl is arranged on its own now.
- Leaving vinyl in Edit fullscreen goes to the layout with lyrics when the song has them.
- The Media page's waveform no longer stops for good after a quiet moment in a song.

> [!NOTE]
> The executable is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may show an "unknown publisher" warning the first time. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
